import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform

def invoke_model(project_id, location, endpoint_id, instances):
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    endpoint = aiplatform.Endpoint(endpoint_id)
    predictions = endpoint.predict(instances=instances)
    return predictions

if __name__ == "__main__":

    result = invoke_model(project_id, location, endpoint_id, instances)
    print(result)

import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform

def select_model(project_id, location, model_name):
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    model = aiplatform.Model.list(filter=f'display_name={model_name}')[0]
    return model.resource_name

if __name__ == "__main__":
    project_id = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')
    location = 'us-central1'
    model_name = 'your-model-name'
    result = select_model(project_id, location, model_name)
    print(result)

import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform

def stream_generation(project_id, location, endpoint_id, instances):
    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)
    endpoint = aiplatform.Endpoint(endpoint_id)
    predictions = endpoint.predict(instances=instances, streaming=True)
    for prediction in predictions:
        yield prediction

if __name__ == "__main__":
    project_id = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')
    location = 'us-central1'
    endpoint_id = 'your-endpoint-id'
    instances = [{'content': 'Hello, world!'}]
    for prediction in stream_generation(project_id, location, endpoint_id, instances):
        print(prediction)

import os
from google.cloud import translate

def translate_text(project_id, text, target_language):
    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()
    parent = f'projects/{project_id}/locations/global'
    response = client.translate_text(parent, text, target_language)
    return response.translations[0].translated_text

if __name__ == "__main__":
    project_id = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')
    text = 'Hello, world!'
    target_language = 'es'
    result = translate_text(project_id, text, target_language)
    print(result)

import os
from google.cloud import texttospeech

def generate_audio(project_id, text):
    client = texttospeech.TextToSpeechClient()
    input_text = texttospeech.SynthesisInput(text=text)
    voice = texttospeech.VoiceSelectionParams(language_code='en-US', ssml_gender=texttospeech.SsmlVoiceGender.NEUTRAL)
    audio_config = texttospeech.AudioConfig(audio_encoding=texttospeech.AudioEncoding.MP3)
    response = client.synthesize_speech(input=input_text, voice=voice, audio_config=audio_config)
    with open('output.mp3', 'wb') as out:
        out.write(response.audio_content)
    return 'output.mp3'

if __name__ == "__main__":
    project_id = os.getenv('GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT')
    text = 'Hello, world!'
    result = generate_audio(project_id, text)
    print(result)
